statement: Reconstruct the scoped anonymous Walmart shopping experience: enter through the public retail home, browse household or personal-care departments, search and refine a compact product catalog, inspect prices, ratings, fulfillment and product options, add and manage a site-isolated local cart, validate a delivery ZIP, and stop at a truthful non-payment checkout review. The candidate creates no source-site mutation, account, order, message, payment, or external runtime request.
simulations: Pickup and shipping dates are deterministic local display data, not source inventory promises.
Ratings and representative review copy are compact fixture data grounded structurally in current public product cards.
Checkout ends at review and disables place-order; no payment method, order receipt, email, or source effect exists.
out_of_scope: Source-side cart mutation and checkout because the run has no source mutation authority.

Login, registration, password recovery, credentials, OTPs, accounts, lists, address book, order history, shipment tracking, cancellation, returns, refunds, gift cards, and promotional-code redemption.
Ordering, payment submission, Stripe test or live payment, email, messaging, publication, deployment, push, and pull request creation.
Full Walmart catalog, realtime inventory, dynamic merchandising, advertisements, telemetry, third-party recommendations, and geographic fulfillment accuracy.
